name: hive-desktop
description: HIVE Desktop — Electron demo shell for the HIVE agent runtime

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.dev:debug: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron . --remote-debugging-port=9333"
